page_title: MAR 0-2 PSG | Marseille v PSG 31/03/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' That's the end of the match.

90+4' A flowing move ends with a great cross into the centre of the box, which Samuel Gigot (Marseille) latches onto but sends a wild header well wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and PSG will have a goal kick.
90' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
90' Great save! Amine Harit (Marseille) had time and space inside the box after picking up a neat pass, but his shot towards the bottom left corner was brilliantly saved by Gianluigi Donnarumma.
85' 0 - 2 Goal! Goncalo Ramos (PSG) with a wonderful piece of finishing. He makes a yard for himself after a well-taken pass inside the box and strikes the ball into the bottom left corner.
85' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Marseille comes to nothing.
85' There's a melee in the box, but the referee isn't interested in the appeals from Marseille for a penalty. Play continues.
83' The corner is swung in but PSG can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
82' The ball is cleared after Achraf Hakimi (PSG) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. PSG earn a corner.
81' Faris Moumbagna (Marseille) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.

79' A neat pass is well received by Pierre-Emerick Aubameyang (Marseille), who is lurking on the edge of the box and strikes the ball towards the bottom right corner, but the goalkeeper makes an incredible save to block his shot.
77' Warren Zaire-Emery will be replaced by Milan Skriniar (PSG).
76' Marseille have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
76' Quentin Merlin (Marseille) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Gianluigi Donnarumma intercepts the ball. Marseille have been awarded a corner kick.
75' Marseille seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
73' We are about to witness a substitution. Azzedine Ounahi (Marseille) is replacing Leonardo Balerdi.
69' None of the PSG players could reach the corner kick as the ball was overhit and goes out of play.
68' Achraf Hakimi (PSG) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. The ball goes behind for a corner. PSG will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
67' A quickly taken corner by Marseille.
65' That will be all from Fabian Ruiz who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Manuel Ugarte (PSG).
65' Here is a change. Ousmane Dembele is going off and Luis Enrique gives the last tactical orders to Marco Asensio (PSG).
65' Kylian Mbappe goes off the pitch and Goncalo Ramos (PSG) comes on.
64' Kylian Mbappe (PSG) sprays a pass out to Achraf Hakimi, but he can't beat his man to get to the ball.
61' Substitution. Geoffrey Kondogbia is replaced by Pape Gueye (Marseille).
61' Jean-Louis Gasset has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Faris Moumbagna (Marseille) replacing Iliman Ndiaye.
59' Jordan Veretout (Marseille) has a goal ruled out for offside!
57' PSG hold the ball and display nice passing from player to player.
54' Ousmane Dembele (PSG) attempts to find Kylian Mbappe with a delicate little through ball from inside the box, but one of the defending players makes a timely intervention.
53' 0 - 1 Goal! Ousmane Dembele shows great vision to find Vitinha (PSG) with a cheeky pass inside the box, and his first-time shot is precise and sails into the bottom left corner. 0:1.
51' Chancel Mbemba just cannot continue due to injury and has to be substituted. Samuel Gigot (Marseille) replaces him.
49' Chancel Mbemba (Marseille) is asking for medical treatment, but he will have to leave the pitch in order to receive help from the physio.
47' A promising cross into the box is nearly received by the lurking Pierre-Emerick Aubameyang (Marseille), but one of the defending players cuts it out to avert the threat.
46' The substitution is prepared. Kang-In Lee (PSG) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Randal Kolo Muani.
46' The whistle blows and Benoit Bastien starts the second half.
45+3' The match has reached half-time.
45' 2 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' Gianluigi Donnarumma (PSG) receives a yellow card.
40' The referee cannot ignore such behaviour. Danilo Pereira (PSG) sees a yellow card and needs to watch himself for the rest of the game.
40' Lucas Beraldo (PSG) is given his marching orders with a straight red card! For us, it was a very harsh one.
38' The referee can't ignore those comments and Lucas Hernandez (PSG) sees a yellow card for bad language.
36' Kylian Mbappe (PSG) latches on to a pin-point through ball, but one of the defending players dispossess him. Brilliant defending.
33' Geoffrey Kondogbia (Marseille) clips a neat ball into the box in the direction of Pierre-Emerick Aubameyang, but he can't get on the end of the pass.

31' Great solo effort from Ousmane Dembele (PSG)! He beat a couple of players and shot from the edge of the box, but the effort slips just wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Marseille.
30' Pau Lopez displays his ability to read the game and clears the danger after Randal Kolo Muani (PSG) threatened to latch onto a through ball from just outside the box.
27' Ousmane Dembele (PSG) received a clever through ball which could have put him in a promising position, but the defence was alert to the danger.
26' Luis Henrique (Marseille) tries to create a chance, but puts too much weight on his pass.
21' PSG take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
21' Ousmane Dembele (PSG) nearly creates a chance, but his attempt to pick out a teammate with a through ball does not come off. PSG will take a corner kick.
20' Achraf Hakimi (PSG) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Benoit Bastien has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
17' Jordan Veretout (Marseille) was close to scoring after he unleashed a powerful shot which went a whisker wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and PSG will have a goal kick.
15' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Lucas Beraldo (PSG) was quite harsh and Benoit Bastien didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
14' The keeper makes a simple save after Pierre-Emerick Aubameyang (Marseille) received a short pass and shot low from the edge of the box towards the middle of the goal.
14' Benoit Bastien couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Achraf Hakimi (PSG) and blew his whistle.

12' Pierre-Emerick Aubameyang (Marseille) is picked out by one of his teammates with a brilliant long-range cross, but he doesn't control the ball well and the defence eliminates the danger without any problem.
9' Marseille quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
9' Quentin Merlin (Marseille) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear. Marseille will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
8' Ulisses Garcia (Marseille) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
6' Jordan Veretout (Marseille) will take a corner kick.
5' Fabian Ruiz (PSG) strikes the rebound, but it goes well over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Marseille.
5' Ousmane Dembele (PSG) serves up a nice cross, but Pau Lopez punches the ball away.
3' Great teamplay by PSG as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.

The players are on the pitch and PSG will have the kick-off.
Today's referee will be Benoit Bastien.
